definitions.explanation: An extremely small piece or particle. Often used in cooking to describe finely chopped ingredients (みじん{切|ぎ}り).

definitions.gloss: the slightest bit; not at all (in negative expressions)
definitions.explanation: Used with negative expressions to emphasize the complete absence of something — not even the tiniest amount.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}ねぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{微塵|みじん}{切|ぎ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
にんにく⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{微塵|みじん}{切|ぎ}りにして⟦{炒|いた}める→炒める：01879_itameru⟧。
examples.english: Mince the garlic and stir-fry it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧{微塵|みじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砕|くだ}けた→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧。
examples.english: The vase fell and shattered into tiny pieces.
He doesn't show the slightest sign of remorse.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと{微塵|みじん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I didn't think that at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疑|うたが}い→疑い：09757_utagai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{微塵|みじん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{信|しん}じていた→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
examples.english: Without the slightest doubt, I completely trusted her.

notes:
USAGE:
Two main uses: (1) In cooking, {微塵|みじん}{切|ぎ}り means finely minced or diced. (2) In the pattern {微塵|みじん}も〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, it emphasizes the complete absence of something. Both uses are very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微塵|みじん}{切|ぎ}り (mincing, finely diced)
- {微塵|みじん}も〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not the slightest ~)
- {微塵|みじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砕|くだ}ける→砕ける：04667_kudakeru⟧ (to shatter into fragments)
- {微塵|みじん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{感|かん}じない→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (not to feel in the slightest)
